0.reason: the dispatch_plan.py edit came from the coordinator's resume advice after its widen was refused; it is accepted at promotion with a stated reason once the run holding that file releases it

findings.text: follow-on: this file is not among the write paths recorded on the run's own live pointer (which names reckon/crew/dispatch.py and reckon/crew_run_commands.py but not dispatch_plan.py), so the landed diff carries a file outside the run's recorded scope; the manifest's follow_ons states the record names 'the six earlier files', which misstates what the record names. The change itself is the two-line project threading the coordinator's resume advice granted, so reconciliation of the record belongs to the coordinator.

follow-on: _brief_domain_block re-implements the capability reckon/crew/prompts.py:360 domain_rules_block adds in the same change -- both call rules_for and render the block for a (project, node) pair -- so the repository now owns two spellings of one capability. It reuses the owner's renderer (render_domain_rules) but does not extend the owner, and the dispatch.py:1807 and dispatch_plan.py:580 call sites could have called domain_rules_block directly.

follow-on: render_domain_rules emits the heading alone when the matched rule set holds no invariants and no review checks. DomainRules.__bool__ (reckon/crew/domain_rules.py:48) is true when only model_paths matched, and reckon/_flight_schema.py:731 makes model_paths a legal standalone declaration, so a project declaring model paths but no rules gives every matching node a brief carrying a heading with nothing under it.

follow-on: the done_when asks that the gate log show the brief and refusal tests failing on the base commit, and no log does -- the new test file does not exist at base 229715fe9, so the base arm ran only the 11 pre-existing files it lists (87 passed) and the head's delta is measured as an addition of 15 tests rather than a change from red to green. The coordinator's resume advice substituted the negative control, which does redden: negative-control-domain-brief.log reports 4 failed, 11 passed, EXIT=1 against a tree with _require_domain_invariant_checks's body replaced by an immediate return None.

justifications.durability: the negative control reinstates the regression -- _require_domain_invariant_checks's body replaced by an immediate return None -- and tests/test_domain_rules_reach_the_brief.py:247, :280, :313 and :359 redden on it while the other eleven pass, and the brief-half assertions at :168, :173 and :203 read the stored bytes for a heading the code must have written rather than comparing two calls to the same function.
justifications.evidence: gate-domain-brief-head.log records 102 passed EXIT=0 at head, naming its revision, tree and the worktree-resolved module, and gate-domain-brief-base.log records 87 passed EXIT=0 with the base tree on its module line, but the done_when's sentence asking for the new brief and refusal tests failing at the base commit is unmet because the file does not exist there and the negative control stands in its place.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/prompts.py:357 and the new helpers keep the module's existing idiom of a named constant plus a renderer, every name describes its mechanism, and no version, plan or ticket identifier appears in the diff; the only naming-adjacent concern is the bare heading at :402.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/prompts.py:635 composes the matched rules under DOMAIN_RULES_HEADING for the node's write paths, reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:2077 appends the same block to the stored copy its digest covers, and reckon/crew/promotion.py:494 runs each declared check at promotion, so both halves of the goal land.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:870 reuses rerun_gate_at_integrated_revision for the declared checks rather than adding an executor, but reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:1990 forks the capability reckon/crew/prompts.py:360 owns, so the addition duplicates rather than extends the owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff against 229715fe9 touches only the declared product and test paths plus the evidence fragment, but reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:580 is absent from the write_paths recorded on the run's live pointer even though the resume advice granted it, and no path outside the grant is touched.
